effects.description: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] ➁ (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.): If you have 5 Characters, return 1 of your Characters to the owner's hand. Then, play up to 1 Character with a cost of 5 or less from your hand that is a different color than the returned Character.
conditions: You haven't used this effect yet this turn
You have 5 Characters on your field
You have 2 active DON!! cards you can rest
steps: Rest 2 DON!! cards to activate this effect
Choose 1 of your Characters and return it to your hand
(Optional) Play 1 Character from your hand that costs 5 or less and has a different color from the returned Character
notes: You must activate this effect yourself during your Main Phase
You can't use this effect if you don't have 5 Characters on your field
You can choose not to play a new Character after returning one
